--- title: "About" pagetitle: "MHDSR - About" description: "About MHDSR and its instructor." page-layout: full title-block-banner: false execute: echo: false warning: false freeze: auto --- ## MHDSR **What.** MHDSR (Methods in Health Data Science with R) is a live, cohort-based training pathway in applied biostatistics, machine learning, survival analysis, and evidence synthesis, taught in R with reproducible Quarto workflows. It comprises four courses, **BIOSTATR**, **ML4HOR**, **SURV4CR**, and **METAR**, that can be taken independently or followed as a complete pathway. ::: {.cell} ::: {#fig-pathway .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` The MHDSR pathway ::: ::: Each course can be taken independently (no prerequisite is mandatory), but the order above is recommended for participants building comprehensive mastery. ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} **{{< fa bullseye >}} Why** Health researchers are often taught statistics and R as separate subjects, disconnected from the reproducible workflows expected in publication and clinical practice. MHDSR closes that gap: every course pairs the underlying methodology with a hands-on R implementation and ends with a reproducible Quarto report. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} **{{< fa users >}} Who it's for** Clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and analysts who want a rigorous, hands-on introduction to modern health data analysis in R. No advanced statistics background is required for **BIOSTATR**; the other three courses build on it but can be taken independently. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} **{{< fa clipboard-list >}} What you get** Live sessions, slides, notebooks, datasets, and exercises for every session, with direct feedback in a small cohort, ending in a short reproducible Quarto mini-project. ::: ::: [See the full catalogue →](courses/index.qmd) ## The Instructor MHDSR is designed and taught by **Imad El Badisy, PhD**, Research Engineer in Health Data Science. [Read the full profile at elbadisyimad.com →](https://elbadisyimad.com) ## Contact For registration, questions about a course, or group/custom training requests: [elbadisyimad@gmail.com](mailto:elbadisyimad@gmail.com)
